test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical/spelling error.

The sons of the old farmer / fell off after their father / breathed his last / in the village.

options.text: The sons of the old farmer

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"fell off"** typically means to drop or decline from a previous state or position, which is incorrect in this context. (गिरना)

 
 
• **Example: **The quality of his work** fell off** after he got promoted.
 
 
 
• The correct phrase should be **"fell out"**, which means to have a disagreement or argument that results in a separation. (झगड़ा होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The brothers** fell out** after their father passed away.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: in the village **(गाँव में): Refers to the location within the village.

 
 
• **Example:** He grew up in the village and loved the rural life.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: breathed his last **(अपने अंतिम साँस ली): A phrase used to indicate that someone has died.
 
 
• **Example: **He breathed his last peacefully surrounded by his family.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: The sons of the old farmer **(पुराने किसान के बेटे): Refers to the male children of the elderly farmer.
 
 
• **Example: **The sons of the old farmer inherited the land after his death.
 
 

 

2e5:Tc5c,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
